call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the Rs 330 upper band: Neutral value Rs 392 is 18.8% above the price, so Subscribe (Bear Rs 358 is also above). No material issue was found; the Goa pollution notices and weak cash conversion are points to monitor.
headline: India's dominant SBR sewage-treatment technology supplier (705 plants, 29.3% operating margin) priced at 20.9x FY26 earnings at Rs 330, against 31-52x for listed peers; our fair value is Rs 392 (Neutral), so Subscribe. Watch cash conversion (FY26 operating cash flow negative) and the Goa plant notices.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 657.50 -> 697.86 -> 803.63 cr FY24-26 (+15.2% in FY26); operating EBITDA margin about 29%; order book Rs 1,574.52 cr (2.0x revenue) (RHP pp. 188, 412)
Operating cash flow -Rs 25.80 cr in FY26 and -Rs 21.34 cr in Q1 FY27; cumulative FY24-26 CFO 6% of PAT; working capital 76.5% of revenue (pp. 411, 417)
Ten show-cause notices from the Goa pollution board and GWMC to the SWT subsidiaries since Jul-2025, plus an FIR; EUR 5.60 m Portugal claim pending (pp. 554-557)
Offer Rs 667.5 cr at Rs 330: fresh Rs 150 cr + OFS 1.57 crore shares (78%) by sellers with an average cost of Rs 36.72; Rs 28.02 cr interim dividend declared Sep-2026 (cover; p. 510)
At Rs 330: P/E 20.9x post-issue (Ion Exchange 31.3x, Thermax 52.0x); fair value Rs 358 / 392 / 423; reported P/E a fair measure (adjustments -1.0%)

WWT revenue back to growth: +15.7% in FY26 (p. 501)
Profit taxed in cash: current tax 27% of PBT (p. 412)
weaknesses: Operating cash flow negative in FY26 and Q1 FY27 (p. 417)
Working capital 76.5% of revenue; cash conversion cycle 242 days (pp. 188, 411)
Net debt Rs 38.82 cr at Mar-26 after net cash a year earlier (p. 188)
Q1 is seasonally weak: Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 1.48 cr (p. 412)
opportunities: Tertiary treatment market projected at 30.3% CAGR FY26-31 (issuer-paid F&S, p. 173)
CBG plant orders of Rs 501.70 cr with 10-year O&M (p. 300)
DuPont membranes for municipal water reuse (p. 299)
Solar sludge dryers via the IST-Anlagenbau acquisition (p. 312)
threats: Ten pending Goa pollution-board / GWMC notices and an FIR at the SWT plants (pp. 554-556)
EUR 5.60 m (Rs 59.75 cr) claim in Portugal (p. 556)
Municipal payment delays via EPC contractors (p. 31)
